version: Patch 3.3 (Ladder Season 15) — Diablo II: Resurrected Ladder Season 15 is live
schedule: Ladder Season 14 ended — Aug 18 (Tue) 3:00 AM KST
Ladder Season 15 patch rollout began — Aug 19 (Wed)
changes: Non-Ladder (Standard) carryover: Previous Ladder-only items/runewords (Madness, Ground, Metamorphosis, Hearth, Temper, Cure, Bulwark, and related) can now be crafted and used in non-Ladder.
Gear and set balance: Several unique items (e.g. Bloodletter, Battle Branch, Rogues Bow, Snowclash) and set items received option/required-level adjustments.
Terror Zones / drop tuning: Chance for Rare-or-better drops from Herald tier 3+ has increased.
Systems and bug fixes: Jump into the fray with new Ladder items, Terror Zone changes, and assorted bug fixes — see the full notes on the Blizzard page.

schedule: Ladder Season 14 start: May 22, 2026 (PDT) / May 23 9:00 AM KST
Warlock class balance updates and a major Terror Zone system overhaul
changes: Warlock class tuning: Core skill mechanics reworked and damage synergy balance adjusted.
Terror Zones and Herald tiers: Tier 1–3 Heralds now hunt players inside Terror Zones.
Colossal Ancients difficulty: Magic resist and damage mechanics made more threatening.
New class — Warlock: Dark magic and summon trees plus dedicated Warlock gear.
Hardcore Level 99 race: Hardcore Ladder race to 99 celebrating the Warlock launch.
Graphics rendering optimizations, lobby filter improvements, and many client crash fixes.
